description.value: Dubh Linn Gate is a lively Irish pub set inside the Pan Pacific Whistler Mountainside hotel at the base of the Whistler and Blackcomb gondolas, making it one of the most centrally located watering holes in Whistler Village. It pours Whistler's true 20 oz imperial pint from 25 draught taps spanning BC craft breweries, Irish classics like Guinness and Kilkenny, and rotating specialty taps. A full food menu runs from brunch through late-night dinner, and live music most evenings draws a crowd of locals and visiting riders alike.
